notes.title: Demo Patch 1.14
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We've released a small patch with some improvements and fixes.

Changes:

 Improved map path generation. Paths are no longer heavily skewed to the right.
 Improved Polish localization for greater accuracy.


Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Patch 1.13
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
Just a quick patch with some QoL improvements.

Bug Fix:

Anvil blessing now provides the correct amount of extra smelt points for smelting.
Improvements:

 Pressing the right D-pad on the map's rightmost node no longer selects blessings under player stats.
 When opening gear selection, it now automatically selects the first gear in the inventory instead of the back button.
 Improved functionality of the mouse scroll wheel on the map and in the inventory.
Localization:

 Fixed a misspelling in Polish in the opening cutscene.

Thank you for playing the demo! If you have any feedback or encounter any bugs, feel free to share them on the Steam discussion page.

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.12
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
I've just released a small patch. This update contains Patch 1.11 changes that were reverted temporarily and includes a few additional minor fixes outlined below:

Bug Fixes:

 Traditional Chinese language no longer causes players to get stuck on certain "?" nodes (a bug introduced in Patch 1.11).

Localization:

 Corrected an issue where the translations for Dexterity and Intelligence were swapped in Traditional and Simplified Chinese.
If you encounter any issues while playing, please let us know in the Steam discussions.
Thank you so much for playing the demo and supporting the game!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.11
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Here's a small patch with some fixes and new localizations. Thank you so much for playing the demo!

Changes:

 Thebe Upgrade menu now auto selected General Tab instead of Back button.
 The default game brightness now is 50% instead of 75%. This won't change for any existing players.
Bug:

 Steam Input now is enabled by default for all controller types except Xbox Controller. Having steam input enabled should fix any controller issues players been having.
 Wendigo minions no longer drop fungi. To compensate for this, the reward for completing maps has been trippled.
 Game no longer auto selects option buttons behind the pause menu, causing buttons not working in pause menu at all.
 Aghast blessing no longer gives additional 10 forge points when smelting items (behaving like blacksmith blessings).
 Mimic Head no longer gives additional 10 forge points when smelting items (behaving like blacksmith blessings).
Sound:

 Heartbeat volume reduced.
 Intro music transtion to character creation improved.
 Character Creation music changes after some time.
Localization

 Russian Langauge Localization Added.
 Hungarian Langauge Localization Added.
 Corrected french translation for Weapon Scaling.
 One of the German Cartographer texts shortened so it fits the screen properly.

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.10
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 
Thank you so much for playing the demo! I've updated the game with a small patch fixing few issues. 

Bug Fixes:

 Player no longer can get stuck in the ground in the Sanctuary.
 Friends Leaderboard now displays no more than 10 friends.
 Corrected couple english/polish spellings and re-worded some sentances.
 SteamDeck D-Pad now works correctly in the menus.
 In the upgrade menu on close button, pressing up on controller now goes to correct button.
 Keyboard binding for movement now works correctly.


Balance:

 Wooden wand - Attack damage increased from 12-13 to 13-14.
 Iron Dagger - Attack damage increased from 15-16 to 16-17 and it's skill does 5% more damage.
 All weapons and shield now cost exactly 20 gold in shop.
 Undead Goblin Mage's kneeling explosion now includes a pre-explosion particle warning.

 
 Other:

  In upgrade menu at the main hub, currently selected page button is now highlighted.
  Updated Credits
